verdict: PARTIAL - input and memory pass; frame p95 and maximum remain above target
outcome: Delivery: 900.189 seconds, all 27,006 inputs accepted per controller, no host stalls. Active-window p95/max 22.433/54.923 ms; six-live p95/max 22.433/37.580 ms. PSS peaks at 140.192 MiB. Native resolution, all effects, HUD and audio are preserved.

truth.Exists: Audio mailboxes, negotiated HUD deltas, exact-pixel road-mark cache, allocation cleanup and bounded diagnostics are present in source and APK.
truth.Valid: 136 core, 8 link and 27 game tests pass; debug APK assembly passes. Core determinism/steady allocation and audio no-escape-analysis checks remain green.
truth.Wired: Matching installed/frozen delivery APK on AFTKM, no intent extras; six live cars, 168 regions without failures, abilities/HUD/audio and actual browser reconnect/Home behavior observed.
truth.Behaves: Delivery passes full-rate zero-rejection, functional and memory gates. Frame p95/max fail. Actual device Home/reconnect/audio-stop checks pass; intermittent pre-handler receive gaps in other runs remain unresolved.
truth.Felt: Pending owner check: physical-phone control feel, optical latency, listening, sofa readability and art acceptance are not inferred from scripted runs.

findings: Baseline native audio slept on the render thread. The worker plus monitor-free mailboxes removes the measured dependency; native audio CPU p95 is 0.375 ms in the repeated trace.
HUD metadata deltas reduce roughly 25K characters per message to about 1.6K, with unchanged dynamic data and full refresh/reconnect behavior.
Static road marks match all 196,608 audited RGBA pixels and reduce mean render CPU by 1.335 ms in the matched-APK experiment.

Steady audio render allocation falls to zero in the targeted changing-engine test; onsets and other rendering still allocate. Android per-thread allocation is unavailable, so desktop JFR is explicitly a proxy.
Rejected packets cross the unchanged 250 ms age cutoff after shared receive gaps; sequence ordering and ordinary handler/ack-enqueue work do not explain the long delay.
Active texture uploads are zero; 720p did not improve p95. Native image quality and every effect are preserved.
A rejection-triggered native ring captures full 285 ms gaps with 17 render entries, no overlapping app GC and maximum app lock wait 0.047 ms. Kernel packet-arrival timestamps remain unavailable.
limits: Worst overlapping ten-second active-window percentiles are reported separately from unique diagnostic frame percentiles. No pooling or optical/presentation claim.
P0 baseline includes a one-second sampler check. P3 continuous/display, P7 profile and P8 native captures are intrusive. P5 includes an extra full-ring export with measured observer cost.
P6 low-latency Wi-Fi has zero rejects but a 13.629-second host stall and fails qualification. A subsequent lock arm still rejected four packets per seat.
The first final-default run has a 495.470 ms host pump stall. No quiet interval is removed, and all stale-input ages remain visible.
Async audio preserves frame progress but native onset/parameter delays and dropped stale onsets remain visible; listening is still required.

No tested art reduction or pacing slot reaches the original frame targets. Kernel packet-arrival/selector evidence and presentation-level work remain; no unmeasured trade-off is promised as sufficient.
Final audio: three stale onsets discarded, onset completion max 128.616 ms and parameter queue max 179.498 ms; native playback stops on Home. No listening or optical-latency pass.
